Routine eye exam. No complaints except mild blurring at distance when driving at night.
VA sc: OD 20/40, OS 20/40. Manifest refraction: OD -1.25 sph, OS -1.00 -0.25 x 180 → 20/20 OU.

NUTRITION CONSULT — INITIAL
Date: 12/31/2025
Referred by PCP for weight management (lifestyle modification program).
Pt brought a 1-week food log. Typical day: skips breakfast, fast-food lunch, large dinner, 2 sodas. Evening snacking while watching TV.

Plan developed with patient:
- Mediterranean-style reduced-calorie pattern, ~1400 kcal/day. Emphasis on vegetables, legumes, fish, olive oil in place of butter; smaller starch portions.
- Replace soda with sparkling water; no sugar-sweetened beverages.
- Breakfast daily (Greek yogurt + fruit or eggs + toast).
- Continue logging food in the app she started.
- Activity goal reinforced: stationary bike 30–40 min 4 days/week.
Goals: 3 meals/day, no SSBs, food log 5+ days/week. RD follow-up in ~6 weeks, then per program schedule.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE
Date: 03/07/2026
S: Follow-up for weight and BP. Continues the diet and activity plan started in December — logging food most days, no soda since January, on the bike 3–4 times a week. Has had a couple of off weeks with sick kids but otherwise sticking with it. Saw the dietitian end of December. No chest pain, no SOB, no headaches.
O: Wt 98.2 kg, BMI 37.0. BP 135/79, HR 72.

PRIMARY CARE PROGRESS NOTE

S: Follow-up weight and BP. Continues the Mediterranean-style plan and bike workouts; still attending program follow-ups and RD visits. Logs food most days. O: Wt 96.7 kg, BMI 36.4. BP 142/87, HR 78.
